title: E3CS-039 PARTICLE DETECTOR INSTRUMENT TO SEARCH FOR STRANGE QUARK MATTER SQM-ISS - EXPRO+
description: SQM-ISS will perform the first large systematic search - using active detectors - of slow-moving massive particles in cosmic rays, such as Strange Quark Matter (SQM), primordial black holes and other new particles. The SQM-ISS instrument uses a dual detector setup consisting of scintillator and piezoelectric detectors, which allows to probe a very wide range of particle types, mass and energies, ensuring a high probability of discovery of such new particles. In absence of any signal, the SQM-ISS instrument will allow to establish an upper limit for a wide range of particle fluxes.
